Project.title: Project
Project.description: A user-created app or website project containing code files and metadata

id.description: The unique document identifier of the project

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this project

title.description: Title or name of the project

description.description: Short description of what the project builds or does

htmlContent.description: HTML markup for the web application

activeLanguage.description: Primary workspace target such as web, python, or java

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation. Clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update. Clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A conversational message exchanged between the user and CodeForge AI

id.description: The unique document identifier of the message

userId.description: The UID of the user owning this conversation

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation. Clients submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Stores user authored code projects and web files

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/mes.description: Stores conversation history for a specific project
